answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 10464 Country: India Title: What about performing Sunnat (Salah) during salat-e-fazr (fardh) in the mosque Question: What about performing Sunnat (Salah) during salat-e-fazr (fardh) in the mosque Answer ID: 10464 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 206/191=B/1429) It is mentioned in Hadith: إذ ا أقیمت الصلاۃ فلا صلاۃ إلا المکتوبۃ When the fardh salah is being performed, one should not perform any salah (like sunnah and nafl) except the fardh. Yet, it may be allowable if it is performed behind any partition or wall. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
